rules.statement: A Court has full power to conduct a local inspection under Section 428 of the Civil Procedure Code, and where parties agree to abide by the Court's decision after an inspection, there is implied in it a waiver of all defences taken in the answer and a total acceptance of the outcome of the Court's decision after the agreed inspection. The judgment and decree then are of consent of the parties and there is no right of appeal.
